name: Gruk Ironhide

abilities.name: Brutal Strike
abilities.description: A savage overhead chop designed to cleave through armor

abilities.name: Intimidating Roar
abilities.description: Bellows a terrifying war cry that can shake enemies' resolve

appearance.distinctive_features: Missing left tusk, ritual scars across chest, collection of bone trophies on belt

personality.demeanor: Speaks little, growls often, constantly scanning for threats with hand on weapon
personality.speaking_style: Grunts and broken common speech, uses simple words, often gestures instead of speaking

beliefs: Serve the strongest chief without question
Take what you can, keep what you can hold
philosophy.approach_to_conflict: Attacks first, thinks later. Fights with overwhelming aggression and raw power. Will defend his position to the death if ordered. Targets the biggest threat first. Shows no mercy and expects none. Will not flee unless commanded to do so by the Witch King.

visible: Heavy hide armor reinforced with iron plates

secrets: Fears magical fire due to childhood trauma
Actually quite intelligent for an orc but hides it to avoid extra responsibilities
Secretly doubts the Witch King will keep his promises
backstory: Former war-band lieutenant who was captured and given a choice: serve the Witch King or die. Chose service. Now guards the throne room, hoping to eventually escape with enough loot to start his own war-band. Keeps his thoughts to himself and follows orders.
